<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Tattoo Business Assistant</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#050506">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="INK.OS">
<meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" id="appleIcon" href="icon-512.png">
<link rel="icon" id="favIcon" href="icon-192.png">
<link rel="manifest" href="#" id="manifestLink">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0a0908;
  --bg2:#121110;
  --panel:#161413;
  --panel2:#1d1a18;
  --line:#2a2523;
  --line-red:#4a1614;
  --red:#c62b28;
  --red-soft:#e5453f;
  --red-glow:rgba(198,43,40,.55);
  --text:#eee8e4;
  --text-dim:#a89e98;
  --text-mute:#6f655f;
  --green:#2ecc71;
  --yellow:#f1c40f;
  --blue:#2563EB;
  --radius:14px;
  --sea:#20B2AA;--yel:#F4C542;--redEv:#E53935;--pur:#8E44AD;--cor:#FF7F50;--blu:#2563EB;--sky:#60A5FA;--gray:#808080;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;height:100%;overflow:hidden;}
body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line-red);border-radius:4px;}
a{color:var(--red-soft);}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Arial Black',Impact,-apple-system,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:0 0 8px;}
.graffiti{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#cfc8c4 60%,var(--red-soft));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;text-shadow:0 0 18px var(--red-glow);}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;color:var(--text);}
button{cursor:pointer;}
.btn{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);padding:0 16px;height:40px;line-height:38px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:.15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;vertical-align:middle;white-space:nowrap;}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d43530,#a91f1c);border:1px solid #7a1513;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--red-glow),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
.btn-primary::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-60%;width:40%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);transition:left .5s;}
.btn-primary:hover::after{left:130%;}
.btn-outline-neon{background:#120c0c;border:1.5px solid var(--red);color:var(--text);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow),inset 0 0 10px rgba(198,43,40,.12);}
.btn-outline-neon:hover{box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--red-glow),inset 0 0 14px rgba(198,43,40,.2);}
.tile-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;}
.segmented{display:flex;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:12px;padding:4px;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;}
.segmented button{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;}
.segmented button.active{background:var(--panel2);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.icon-stat-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;text-align:center;}
.icon-stat-card .ic-wrap{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(198,43,40,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 6px;}
.icon-stat-card .ic-wrap svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--red-soft);}
.icon-stat-card .n{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;}
.icon-stat-card .l{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:2px;}
.analytics-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;}
.analytics-card .ic-wrap{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(198,43,40,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.analytics-card .ic-wrap svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--red-soft);}
.analytics-card .body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.analytics-card .l{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);}
.analytics-card .n{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;}
.trend{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-left:6px;}
.trend.up{color:#2ecc71;}
.trend.down{color:#f87171;}
.tile{background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);transition:.15s;}
.tile:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--red-glow);color:var(--text);}
.tile .ic{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--red-soft);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--red-glow));}
.greet-hero{position:relative;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(120% 120% at 15% 0%,rgba(198,43,40,.18),transparent 60%),var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);}
.greet-hero h2{margin:0;font-size:20px;}
.greet-hero .sub{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px;}
.hero-stat{background:rgba(198,43,40,.1);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:center;min-width:56px;}
.hero-stat .n{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red-soft);text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);line-height:1.1;}
.hero-stat .l{font-size:9px;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-top:2px;}
.type-tile-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;}
.type-tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);text-align:center;}
.type-tile:hover{border-color:var(--red);}
.type-tile .d{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;}
.action-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:8px;text-align:left;}
.action-card:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow);}
/* Today summary card, quick actions, todo list, upcoming card, avatars, progress bars, projects */
.today-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.today-card .row{padding:5px 0;}
.today-card .row .ic{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--red-soft);margin-right:8px;}
.qa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.qa-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);}
.qa-btn:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.qa-btn .ic{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--red-soft);}
.todo-list{margin-bottom:14px;}
.todo-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;}
.todo-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.todo-item .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--red-glow);flex-shrink:0;}
.todo-item span.t{flex:1;font-size:13px;}
.upcoming-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;}
.avatar-circle{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel2),#1c1615);border:1px solid var(--line-red);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--red-soft);flex-shrink:0;font-size:15px;}
.avatar-circle.sm{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:12px;}
.progress-track{height:6px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px;}
.progress-track>div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),var(--red-soft));border-radius:4px;}
.project-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(142,68,173,.15);border:1px solid #8E44AD;color:#c99ee0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.session-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);}
.session-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.session-check{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line-red);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:11px;}
.session-check.done{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#04240f;}
.action-card .cnt{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;min-width:26px;height:26px;padding:0 8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
.topbar-tip-btn{position:relative;}
.btn-sm{padding:0 12px;height:32px;line-height:30px;font-size:12px;border-radius:8px;}
.btn-icon{width:36px;height:36px;padding:0;border-radius:10px;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;border:1px dashed var(--line);}
.btn-danger{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red-soft);}
.btn-block{width:100%;display:flex;}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=date],input[type=time],input[type=tel],input[type=password],input[type=email],input:not([type]),select,textarea{
  width:100%;background:var(--bg2)!important;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;outline:none;color-scheme:dark;color:var(--text)!important;
}
input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=date],input[type=time],input[type=tel],input[type=password],input[type=email],input:not([type]),textarea{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
}
input:-webkit-autofill,input:-webkit-autofill:hover,input:-webkit-autofill:focus,textarea:-webkit-autofill,select:-webkit-autofill{
  -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 0 0 1000px var(--bg2) inset;transition:background-color 9999s ease-in-out 0s;caret-color:var(--text);
}
select option{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text);}
input[type=date],input[type=time]{min-width:0;}
input[type=file]{background:var(--bg2);border:1px dashed var(--line-red);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);width:100%;}
input[type=file]::file-selector-button,input[type=file]::-webkit-file-upload-button{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--red);color:var(--text);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-right:10px;cursor:pointer;}
input[type=file]::file-selector-button:hover,input[type=file]::-webkit-file-upload-button:hover{box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(198,43,40,.15);}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:10px 0 4px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;}
.field-row{align-items:flex-end;}
.field-row label{min-height:2.4em;}
.field-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.field-row>div{flex:1;min-width:120px;}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:14px;position:relative;}
.card-red{border-color:var(--line-red);}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:2px 4px 2px 0;cursor:pointer;}
.chip.active{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red-soft);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
.chip-solid.active{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.contact-ic-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 4px;}
.contact-ic-row a,.contact-ic-row span,.contact-ic-row button{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text-dim);text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;padding:0;cursor:pointer;}
.contact-ic-row a svg,.contact-ic-row span svg,.contact-ic-row button svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:currentColor;}
.contact-ic-row a:hover,.contact-ic-row button:hover{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
.contact-ic-row a.filled{color:var(--red-soft);border-color:var(--line-red);}
.contact-ic-row button.empty{opacity:.5;border-style:dashed;}
.contact-ic-row button.empty:hover{opacity:1;}
.ref-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:6px;}
.ref-grid img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line-red);}
.ref-add{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px dashed var(--line-red);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--red-soft);font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--bg2);}
.ref-add:hover{box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;}
.badge-new{background:#1c3a2a;color:#4ade80;}
.badge-vip{background:#3a2a1c;color:#f1c40f;}
.badge-regular{background:#1c2a3a;color:#60a5fa;}
.badge-lost{background:#3a1c1c;color:#f87171;}
.badge-wait{background:#2a2a1c;color:#e5e542;}
.badge-inactive{background:#232323;color:#888;}
.grid{display:grid;gap:12px;}
.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
.grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
@media(max-width:720px){.grid-3,.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
@media(max-width:520px){.grid-2,.grid-3,.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.stat{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;}
.stat .num{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red-soft);text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.stat .lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;}
.muted{color:var(--text-mute);}
.dim{color:var(--text-dim);}
.small{font-size:12px;}
.hidden{display:none!important;}
.scroll-x{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;}
.scroll-x::-webkit-scrollbar{height:6px;}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;}
th,td{padding:8px 6px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
th{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;}
tr:hover td{background:rgba(198,43,40,.05);}

/* Skull/graffiti bg pattern */
.bgpattern{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.05;pointer-events:none;background-repeat:repeat;background-size:180px 180px;}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;width:100%;}

/* Splash */


/* Layout: topbar + content + bottom nav (mobile) / sidebar (desktop) */
#topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);z-index:5;}
#topbar .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:14px;}
#topbar .brand .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
#main{flex:1;display:flex;overflow:hidden;}
#sidebar{width:210px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);padding:10px;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;overflow-y:auto;}
#sidebar .nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-dim);}
#sidebar .nav-item.active,#sidebar .nav-item:hover{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);}
#sidebar .nav-item.active{border-left:3px solid var(--red);box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px var(--red-glow);}
#content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px;padding-bottom:80px;}
#bottomnav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;z-index:20;padding:4px 0 max(4px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
#bottomnav .nav-item{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:6px 2px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;}
#bottomnav .nav-item .ic{font-size:18px;filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.9);}
#bottomnav .nav-item.active{color:var(--red-soft);}
#bottomnav .nav-item.active .ic{filter:none;text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
#moreSheet{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);z-index:50;display:none;align-items:flex-end;}
#moreSheet .sheet{background:#050505;width:100%;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;padding:16px;max-height:78vh;overflow-y:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line-red);}
#moreSheet .sheet-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;position:relative;transition:.12s;}
#moreSheet .sheet-item:active{border:1px solid var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
#moreSheet .sheet-item .ic{color:#666;flex-shrink:0;}
#moreSheet .sheet-item .nbadge{position:absolute;left:26px;top:8px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red-soft);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--red-glow);}
.sheet-handle{width:40px;height:4px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;margin:0 auto 10px;}

/* Generic bottom sheet (reusable) */
#genericSheetOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);z-index:150;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;}
#genericSheetOverlay.open{display:flex;}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet{background:var(--panel);width:100%;max-width:640px;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;padding:16px;max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-bottom:none;box-shadow:0 -10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);animation:sheetUp .22s ease-out;}
@keyframes sheetUp{from{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet-header h3{margin:0}
#genericSheetOverlay.centered{align-items:center;padding:14px;}
#genericSheetOverlay.centered .gsheet{border-radius:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-red);max-width:420px;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);animation:centerPop .18s ease-out;}
@keyframes centerPop{from{transform:scale(.94);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}

/* Icon system */
.ico{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;}
.navbtn{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:6px 4px;color:#555;flex:1;}
.navbtn .ico{width:22px;height:22px;color:#555;transition:.15s;}
.navbtn.active{color:#fff;}
.navbtn.active .ico{color:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--red-glow)) drop-shadow(0 0 2px var(--red-glow));}
.navbtn .nlabel{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;font-weight:700;}
.navbtn .nbadge{position:absolute;top:2px;right:22%;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red-soft);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--red-glow);}
.bell-btn{position:relative;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.bell-btn .ico{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--text);}
.bell-btn .bell-badge{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--red-soft);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);border:1px solid #200;}

@media(min-width:900px){
  #sidebar{display:flex;}
  #bottomnav{display:none;}
  #content{padding-bottom:14px;}
}

/* Modal */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;}
.modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.modal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line-red);border-radius:16px;max-width:560px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);}
.modal-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
.modal-header .x{background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:20px;}
.tabbar{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.tabbar button{background:none;border:none;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;}
.tabbar button.active{color:var(--red-soft);border-bottom-color:var(--red);}
.toast-wrap{position:fixed;top:73px;right:12px;z-index:200;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);}
.toast{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--red-glow);max-width:280px;}
.pin-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#050505;z-index:900;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;}
.pin-dots{display:flex;gap:12px;}
.pin-dots span{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);}
.pin-dots span.filled{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow);}
.pin-pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,64px);gap:12px;}
.pin-pad button{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:20px;}
.progress{height:6px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;}
.progress>div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),var(--red-soft));}
.day-cell{border:1px solid var(--line);min-height:44px;padding:4px;border-radius:8px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;}
.day-cell:hover{border-color:var(--red);}
.day-cell.today{border-color:var(--red-soft);}
.day-cell .dnum{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.day-cell.today .dnum{background:var(--red);color:#fff;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow);}
.evt-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;margin:1px;}
.evt-bar{font-size:9px;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 4px;margin-top:2px;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.camera-frame{border:4px solid var(--red);border-radius:12px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#000;}
.camera-frame.bad{border-color:#e53935;}
.camera-frame.warn{border-color:#f1c40f;}
.camera-frame.good{border-color:#2ecc71;}
.help-toc a{display:block;padding:6px 0;color:var(--text-dim);border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:13px;}
.gauge{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;}
::placeholder{color:var(--text-mute);}
.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);}

.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
.table-wrap table{min-width:480px;}
td,th{word-break:break-word;}
.qty-stepper{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.qty-stepper button{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1;color:var(--text);}
.qty-stepper button:hover{border-color:var(--red);}
.grid-auto{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));}
@media(max-width:520px){.grid-auto{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
#printArea{display:none;}
#printArea img{width:100%;display:block;page-break-after:always;}
@media print{
  html,body{height:auto!important;overflow:visible!important;background:#fff!important;}
  body>*:not(#printArea){display:none!important;}
  body *{visibility:hidden;}
  #printArea,#printArea *{visibility:visible;}
  #printArea{display:block;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;background:#fff;color:#000;padding:24px;}
}

/* ===== INK.OS v2 — theme matching the mockup ===== */
:root{--bg:#050506;--bg2:#08080a;--panel:#0d0d10;--panel2:#141418;--line:#25252b;--line-red:#3a1519;--red:#e11f2b;--red-soft:#ff3d47;--red-glow:rgba(240,40,52,.45);--text:#f3f3f5;--text-dim:#9b9ba6;--text-mute:#63636d;--green:#3ddc84;--radius:12px}
html,body{background:#050506}
body{font-family:'SF Pro Text',Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0}
.bgpattern{display:none}
#content>*{max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
#topbar{background:transparent;border:0;padding:14px 16px 6px}
#topbar .brand .dot{display:none}
#topbar .brand{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;text-transform:none;gap:10px}
#topbar .logo b{color:var(--red-soft);font-weight:800}
#topbarSub{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
#topbarSub .ico{width:20px;height:20px}
#topbar[data-route=dashboard] #topbarSub{display:none}
#topbar:not([data-route=dashboard]) .logo{display:none}
.bell-btn{background:transparent;border:0;width:36px;height:36px}
.card,.stat,.analytics-card,.icon-stat-card,.action-card,.tile{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#111115,#0c0c0f);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:none}
.stat .num{color:var(--text);text-shadow:none}
label{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.btn{background:#121216;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f0313c,#b3141f);border-color:#8a0f18}
.qa-btn{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c0a0d,#0f0709);border:1px solid #6b1a21;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 14px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(225,31,43,.1)}
.segmented{background:#0a0a0d;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:3px}
.segmented button.active,#calViewTabs button.active{background:#16161b;color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow)}
.tabbar button{text-transform:none}
#calViewTabs{background:#0a0a0d;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:3px}
#calViewTabs button{flex:1;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px}
#bottomnav{background:rgba(6,6,8,.97);border-top:1px solid #1d1d22;box-shadow:0 -1px 0 rgba(225,31,43,.3),0 -10px 30px rgba(225,31,43,.07)}
.navbtn,.navbtn .ico{color:#6a6a74}
.navbtn .nlabel{text-transform:none;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:500}
.navbtn.active,.navbtn.active .ico{color:var(--red-soft)}
.dash-head{margin:6px 0 14px}.dash-head h2{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 4px}
.dh-date{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-mute)}
.sec-label{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:18px 2px 8px}
.today-card2{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;background:radial-gradient(90% 140% at 100% 0%,rgba(225,31,43,.18),transparent 60%),#0d0d10}
.tc-row{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px}
.tc-row .ico{color:var(--red-soft);width:16px;height:16px;margin-right:6px}
.todo-list2{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.todo-row,.up-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.todo-row .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red-soft);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow)}
.todo-row .t{flex:1}
.todo-row>.ico,.up-card>.ico,.ev-end .ico{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--text-mute)}
.up-ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 25%,#0d0d10);border:1px solid var(--c);color:#fff}
.up-time{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15}
.up-time small{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-mute);font-weight:500}
.up-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.mcal{background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.mc-head,.mc-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);text-align:center}
.mc-head span{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-mute);padding:4px 0 8px}
.mc{background:none;border:0;padding:3px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;height:46px}
.mn{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12.5px}
.mc.today .mn{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red-glow);font-weight:700}
.mc.sel .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--red-soft)}
.mc.today.sel .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 0 12px var(--red-glow)}
.md{display:flex;gap:2px;height:5px}.md i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%}
.sel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:16px 2px 10px}
.sel-head b{font-size:14px;display:block}.sel-head b::first-letter{text-transform:uppercase}
.ev-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.ev-t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:62px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.ev-t i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
.ev-bar{width:2px;align-self:stretch;border-radius:2px}
.ev-b{flex:1;min-width:0}.ev-b b{font-size:13.5px}
.ev-end.ok .ico{color:var(--green)}
.fin-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.fin-card{border-radius:12px;padding:12px;background:#0a0f0c;border:1px solid #1f7a4a;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(61,220,132,.07)}
.fin-card.exp{background:#100809;border-color:#8a1b24;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(225,31,43,.1)}
.fin-card .fl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:6px 0 2px}
.fin-card .fv{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.fin-card.inc .ico{color:var(--green)}.fin-card.exp .ico{color:var(--red-soft)}
.profit{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;margin:4px 0 8px}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet{background:#07070a}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet-header{justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px}
#genericSheetOverlay .gsheet-header h3{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.sh-back{background:none;border:0;width:32px;height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text)}
.sh-back .ico{transform:scaleX(-1);width:20px;height:20px}
@media(max-width:600px){#genericSheetOverlay.centered{padding:0}#genericSheetOverlay.centered .gsheet{max-width:none;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;border-radius:0;border:0;animation:none}}

/* ===== client screen ===== */
.modal.client-screen{background:#050506;border:1px solid #2a0f13;padding:14px 14px 18px;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(225,31,43,.15)}
@media(max-width:899px){
  .modal-overlay.client-open{padding:0;align-items:stretch;bottom:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
  .modal.client-screen{max-width:none;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding-top:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
}
.cl-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cl-ttl{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-left:6px}
.cl-ib{background:none;border:0;width:34px;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text)}
.cl-ib .ico{width:19px;height:19px}
.cl-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:6px 0 14px;margin:0 -14px 0;padding-left:14px;background:radial-gradient(70% 120% at 100% 0%,rgba(225,31,43,.2),transparent 70%)}
.cl-hero>*:not(.cl-bgimg){position:relative;z-index:1}
.cl-bgimg{position:absolute!important;right:0;top:0;height:100%;width:58%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.4;filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.1);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 25%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 25%,transparent);pointer-events:none;z-index:0!important}
.cl-av{overflow:hidden;padding:0;cursor:pointer;position:relative}.cl-av img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.cl-av{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#d9d9de;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#3a3a42,#101014);border:2px solid #3a3a42}
.cl-name{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.1;word-break:break-word}
.cl-st{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px}.cl-st i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}
.cl-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:4px 0 14px}
.cl-actions .btn{height:44px;border-radius:10px}.cl-actions .btn .ico{width:17px;height:17px}
.cl-tabs{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:12px}
.cl-tabs button{flex:1;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:-1px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-dim);white-space:nowrap}
.cl-tabs button.active{color:var(--red-soft);border-bottom-color:var(--red)}
.cl-card{background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.cl-lbl{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:10px}
.cl-phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;padding:2px 0}
.cl-phone span{flex:1}.cl-phone .ico:first-child{color:#d9d9de}.cl-phone .ico:last-child{width:16px;color:var(--text-mute)}
.cl-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;margin-top:12px}
.cl-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text-dim)}
.cl-link.telegram{color:#4aa3ff}.cl-link.instagram{color:#b46cff}.cl-link.vk{color:#5b8def}.cl-link.whatsapp{color:#3ddc84}
.cl-add{background:none;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12.5px;padding:8px 12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:4px}
.cl-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px}.cl-ic{display:flex;color:#d9d9de}
.cl-ago{margin-left:auto;font-size:12.5px;text-align:right}.cl-ago.bad{color:var(--red-soft);font-weight:700}
.cl-proj{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer}
.cl-pi{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#1e1038;border:1px solid #7b3fe4;color:#b794ff}
.cl-pi.ok{background:#0e2418;border-color:#2a8a55;color:#3ddc84}.cl-pi .ico{width:17px;height:17px}
.cl-pb{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:14px}.cl-done{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.cl-bar{height:4px;background:#1b1b20;border-radius:3px;margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden}
.cl-bar div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7b3fe4,#b794ff);border-radius:3px}
.cl-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.cl-bottom button{background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim)}
.cl-bottom button .ico{width:18px;height:18px}

/* ===== event / project / inventory screens ===== */
.progress-track{height:8px;background:#17171c}.progress-track>div{box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow)}
.ev-client{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:4px 2px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:10px}
.ev-client b{font-size:18px;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.ev-contacts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:2px 0 12px}
.ev-contacts a,.ev-contacts button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:42px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.ev-contacts .ico{width:18px;height:18px}
.ev-contacts a.call{border-color:#1f7a4a;color:var(--green)}
.ev-contacts a.tg{color:#4aa3ff}.ev-contacts a.ig{color:#b46cff}.ev-contacts a.vk{color:#5b8def}.ev-contacts a.wa{color:#3ddc84}
.ev-contacts button.add{border-style:dashed;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:500}
.fin-forecast{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:#0a0f0c;border:1px dashed #1f7a4a;cursor:pointer}
.fin-forecast .fl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:2px}
.fin-forecast .fv{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--green)}
.fin-forecast .tot{text-align:right}.fin-forecast .tot .fv{color:var(--text)}
.ev-when{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 2px 12px}.ev-when .ico{width:20px;height:20px;color:#d9d9de}.ev-when i{color:var(--text-mute);font-style:normal}
.ev-proj{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(80% 140% at 100% 0%,rgba(123,63,228,.16),transparent 65%),#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer}
.ev-proj .tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}.ev-proj .tag i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%}
.ev-proj h3{font-size:26px;margin:6px 0 4px;font-weight:800}.ev-proj h3 small{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-dim)}
.ev-sum .r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px;padding:6px 0}.ev-sum .r b{font-size:17px}
.ev-sum .r.rest{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:4px;padding-top:10px;color:var(--red-soft)}.ev-sum .r.rest.ok{color:var(--green)}
.ck-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:7px 0;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
.ck{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #3a3a44;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;color:transparent}
.ck .ico{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:3}.ck-row.on .ck{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#06210f;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(61,220,132,.35)}
.ck-sub{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-mute);margin:12px 0 4px;font-weight:700}
.ev-finish{width:100%;height:52px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #ff4b55;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e0222e,#8d0f18);color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--red-glow),inset 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin:4px 0 10px}
.ev-done{text-align:center;padding:14px;border:1px solid #1f7a4a;border-radius:12px;color:var(--green);font-weight:700;background:#0a0f0c;margin-bottom:10px}
.pj-hero{position:relative;margin:0 -14px 12px;padding:4px 14px 8px;overflow:hidden}
.pj-bg{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;height:100%;width:50%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.55;filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.15);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 30%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to left,#000 30%,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.pj-hero>*:not(.pj-bg){position:relative}
.pj-hero h2{font-size:23px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.15}.pj-hero h2 span{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.pj-hero .who{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);cursor:pointer}
.pj-prog{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.pj-bar{flex:1;height:12px;background:#17171c;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.pj-bar div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e0222e,#ff5560);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red-glow)}.pj-prog b{font-size:20px;min-width:52px;text-align:right}
.pj-s{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #1b1b20;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}.pj-s:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.pj-d{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #3a3a44;flex-shrink:0}.pj-s.ok .pj-d{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(61,220,132,.35)}
.pj-n{width:14px;font-weight:600}.pj-t{flex:1;min-width:0}.pj-s.empty .pj-t{color:var(--text-mute)}.pj-h{color:var(--text-dim);min-width:34px;text-align:right;font-size:14px}
.pj-c{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #3a3a44;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:transparent;flex-shrink:0}.pj-c .ico{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:3}.pj-s.ok .pj-c{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#06210f}
.pj-cost{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}.pj-cost big{font-size:32px;font-weight:800}.pj-cost .kk{min-width:150px;font-size:14px}.pj-cost .kk div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:3px 0;color:var(--text-dim)}.pj-cost .kk .g{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.pj-cost .kk .r{color:var(--red-soft);font-weight:700}
.pj-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}.pj-btns button{height:46px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.pj-btns .add{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c0a0d,#0f0709);border:1px solid #8a1b24;color:var(--red-soft);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(225,31,43,.15)}.pj-btns .ph{background:#121216;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text)}
.inv-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim)}
.inv-warn{border:1px solid #4a141a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#140a0c,#0d0d10);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:12px}
.inv-warn .h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--red-soft);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.inv-warn .h svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.inv-w{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #1b1b20;font-size:15px}.inv-w:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.inv-w i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:4px;border:2px solid;flex-shrink:0}.inv-w i.r{border-color:#e0222e;background:rgba(224,34,46,.35)}.inv-w i.y{border-color:#f1c40f;background:rgba(241,196,15,.35)}
.inv-w span:nth-child(2){flex:1}.inv-w b.r{color:var(--red-soft)}.inv-w b.y{color:#f1c40f}
.inv-cat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr 44px 38%;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
.inv-cat .d{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#52525c}.inv-cat b{text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.inv-b{height:9px;background:#17171c;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.inv-b div{height:100%;border-radius:6px}
.inv-b .g{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2fb86c,#5be39b)}.inv-b .y{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d4a90c,#f6d55c)}.inv-b .r{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c01a25,#ff4b55)}
.inv-after{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.inv-after b{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}.inv-after p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim)}
.inv-after button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c0a0d,#0f0709);border:1px solid #8a1b24;color:var(--red-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.inv-top ol{margin:0;padding-left:22px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9}
#moreSheet{z-index:120}
.sk-wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}.sk-wrap canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;touch-action:none}
.sk-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}.sk-tools .btn.on{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow)}
.ref-strip{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}.ref-strip img{width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);flex-shrink:0}
.an-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr 70px;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;padding:5px 0}.an-row b{text-align:right}
.an-big{font-size:26px;font-weight:800}.care-ta{width:100%;min-height:210px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
/* ===== splash: INK.OS (animated) ===== */
#splash{--k:1;--T:calc(4.2s*var(--k));--D:calc(.5s*var(--k));position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;z-index:999;display:flex;justify-content:center;transition:opacity .6s;overflow:hidden;
--sp:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)}
#splash.short{--k:.5}
.sp-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;height:100%}
.sp-ext{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;width:100%;position:relative}
.sp-ext i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;margin-left:-1px;background:#ff2036;box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px rgba(255,32,54,.8),0 0 22px 4px rgba(255,32,54,.35);transform:scaleY(0)}
.sp-top i{transform-origin:top;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 85%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 85%)}
.sp-bot i{transform-origin:top;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.5),transparent 75%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.5),transparent 75%)}
.sp-stage{position:relative;flex:none;width:min(100vw,calc(100vh*.5628));width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh*.5628));aspect-ratio:941/1672}
.sp-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sp) center/100% 100% no-repeat;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.sp-main{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}
.sp-logo{clip-path:inset(44% 26% 45% 26%);opacity:0;filter:brightness(1.5) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,20,50,.95))}
.sp-tip{clip-path:inset(56% 42% 29% 42%);opacity:0;filter:brightness(1.7) drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,20,50,1))}
.sp-glow{position:absolute;inset:-10% -40%;background:radial-gradient(40% 30% at 50% 47%,rgba(255,20,50,.22),transparent 70%);opacity:0;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.sp-scan{position:absolute;left:14%;right:14%;top:0;height:2px;margin-top:-1px;opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.03);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ff3b52 30%,#fff 50%,#ff3b52 70%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 14px 3px rgba(255,32,54,.7)}
#splash .skip{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;opacity:.55;background:transparent;border-color:#3a1519;font-size:12px}
#splash.play .sp-top i{animation:spExt var(--D) cubic-bezier(.5,0,.8,.6) forwards}
#splash.play .sp-bot i{animation:spExt calc(.9s*var(--k)) calc(.5s*var(--k) + var(--T)*.8) cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.3,1) forwards}
#splash.play .sp-main{animation:spMain var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-scan{animation:spScan var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-logo{animation:spLogo var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-tip{animation:spTip calc(1.6s*var(--k)) calc(.5s*var(--k) + var(--T)*.64) ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#splash.play .sp-glow{animation:spGlow calc(3s*var(--k)) calc(.5s*var(--k) + var(--T)*.3) ease-out forwards}
@keyframes spExt{to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes spMain{0%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.5,0,.9,.5)}16%{clip-path:inset(0 0 79.5% 0)}22%{clip-path:inset(0 0 79% 0)}66%{clip-path:inset(0 0 31.5% 0)}80%,100%{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}
@keyframes spScan{0%{top:0;opacity:1;transform:scaleX(.03)}16%{top:20.5%;transform:scaleX(.03)}22%{top:21%;transform:scaleX(.03)}30%{transform:scaleX(1)}66%{top:68.5%;opacity:1;transform:scaleX(1)}80%{top:100%;opacity:.6;transform:scaleX(.5)}84%,100%{top:100%;opacity:0}}
@keyframes spLogo{0%,52%{opacity:0}57%{opacity:.95}61%{opacity:.25}66%{opacity:.8}71%{opacity:.3}78%{opacity:.6}100%{opacity:.45}}
@keyframes spTip{from{opacity:.15}to{opacity:.9}}
@keyframes spGlow{to{opacity:1}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#splash.play *{animation-duration:.01s!important;animation-delay:0s!important}}
/* ===== adaptive: iOS / Android / desktop ===== */
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
@supports(height:100dvh){html,body{height:100dvh}}
*{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{overscroll-behavior:none}
#content{-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior-y:contain}
button,.navbtn,.nav-item,.ev-row,.sheet-item,.todo-row,.up-card,.cl-row,.mc{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
button,.navbtn,.nav-item,.sheet-item{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red-soft);outline-offset:2px}
#app{padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right)}
#topbar{padding-top:max(14px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8px))}
#bottomnav{padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right)}
@media(pointer:coarse){input,select,textarea{font-size:16px!important}}
@media(hover:hover){.btn:hover{border-color:#6b1a21}.ev-row:hover,.todo-row:hover,.up-card:hover,.cl-card:hover{border-color:#3b3b45}#sidebar .nav-item:hover{background:#15151a}}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2a2a31;border-radius:8px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
@media(max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape){#bottomnav .nlabel{display:none}#topbar{padding-top:6px;padding-bottom:2px}#content{padding-bottom:64px}}
@media(min-width:900px){
  #content{padding:22px 36px}#content>*{max-width:980px}
  #topbar{padding:18px 36px 8px}
  #sidebar{background:#07070a;border-right:1px solid #1d1d22;width:236px}
  .qa-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .modal-overlay.client-open{justify-content:flex-end;align-items:stretch;padding:0}
  .modal.client-screen{max-width:540px;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;border-radius:0;border-width:0 0 0 1px;padding:22px 26px;box-shadow:-20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
}
@media(min-width:1280px){#content>*{max-width:1100px}}
/* ===== section designs (cities, data, help, clients, analytics, report) ===== */
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 12px;overflow-x:auto}.chips button{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13.5px}.chips button.on{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a0b10,#12070a);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red-glow)}
.search2{width:100%;background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:6px}
.row2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:11px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #17171c;cursor:pointer}.row2:last-child{border-bottom:0}.row2 .ico{color:var(--text-mute)}
.row2 .b{flex:1;min-width:0}.row2 .b b{display:block;font-size:15.5px}.row2 .st{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;margin-top:5px}.row2 .st i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%}
.city-ph{width:64px;height:56px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid #2a2a31}
.stat2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}.stat2>div{background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px}.stat2 small{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim)}.stat2 b{display:block;font-size:21px;margin:4px 0}
.dlt{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700}.dlt.up{color:var(--green)}.dlt.dn{color:var(--red-soft)}
.donut{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 46%,#000 47%);mask:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 46%,#000 47%)}
.leg{flex:1;font-size:13.5px}.leg div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 0}.leg i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}.leg span{flex:1}
.faq{background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px}.faq summary{list-style:none;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.faq summary::after{content:'›';color:var(--text-mute);font-size:20px;line-height:1;transition:transform .2s}.faq[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}.faq p{margin:0;padding:0 14px 14px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5}
/* ===== mentoring ===== */
.mt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:16px 2px 10px}.mt-head h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-red-o{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c0a0d,#0f0709);border:1px solid #8a1b24;color:var(--red-soft);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(225,31,43,.15)}.btn-red-o .ico{width:16px;height:16px}
.stu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 14px;background:#0d0d10;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer}
.stu .cl-av{width:52px;height:52px;font-size:17px;flex-shrink:0}.stu .mid{flex:1;min-width:0}.stu b{font-size:16px}
.stu-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim)}.stu-bar{flex:1;height:7px;background:#1b1b21;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.stu-bar div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e0222e,#ff5560);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red-glow)}
.lessons .l{display:grid;grid-template-columns:74px 48px 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:14px;padding:6px 0}.lessons .l span:first-child{font-weight:700}.lessons .l span:nth-child(2){color:var(--text-dim)}
.hw-hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #3a2a78;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a1038,#0f0a24);cursor:pointer}.hw-hero .cl-av{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}.hw-hero b{display:block;font-size:14.5px}.hw-hero .b{flex:1;min-width:0}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="splash">
  <div class="sp-col">
    <div class="sp-ext sp-top"><i></i></div>
    <div class="sp-stage"><div class="sp-glow"></div><div class="sp-img sp-main"></div><div class="sp-img sp-logo"></div><div class="sp-img sp-tip"></div><div class="sp-scan"></div></div>
    <div class="sp-ext sp-bot"><i></i></div>
  </div>
  <button class="btn skip" id="skipSplash">Пропустить</button>
</div>

<div class="pin-screen hidden" id="pinScreen">
  <div class="graffiti" style="font-size:22px">INK.OS</div>
  <div class="pin-dots" id="pinDots"></div>
  <div class="pin-pad" id="pinPad"></div>
  <div class="small dim" id="pinMsg"></div>
</div>

<div class="bgpattern" id="bgPattern"></div>

<div id="app" class="hidden">
  <div id="topbar">
    <div class="brand" onclick="go('dashboard')" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="logo">INK<b>.OS</b></span><span id="topbarSub"></span></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button class="bell-btn" id="searchBtn" aria-label="Поиск">
        <svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="bell-btn hidden" id="tipsBtn" aria-label="Советы владельцу">
        <svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18h6M10 21h4M12 3a6 6 0 0 0-3.5 10.9c.6.4 1 1.1 1 1.9v.2h5v-.2c0-.8.4-1.5 1-1.9A6 6 0 0 0 12 3Z"/></svg>
        <span class="bell-badge hidden" id="tipsCount"></span>
      </button>
      <button class="bell-btn" id="notifBtn" aria-label="Уведомления">
        <svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 10a6 6 0 1 1 12 0c0 4 1.5 5.5 2 6H4c.5-.5 2-2 2-6Z"/><path d="M10 20a2 2 0 0 0 4 0"/></svg>
        <span class="bell-badge hidden" id="notifCount"></span>
      </button>
      <button class="bell-btn" id="lockBtn" aria-label="Блокировка">
        <svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="main">
    <div id="sidebar"></div>
    <div id="content"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="bottomnav"></div>
</div>

<div id="moreSheet"><div class="sheet" id="moreSheetInner"></div></div>
<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay"><div class="modal" id="modalBody"></div></div>
<div id="genericSheetOverlay"><div class="gsheet" id="genericSheetBody"></div></div>
<div class="toast-wrap" id="toastWrap"></div>

<script>
/* ====================== APP STATE / CONSTANTS ====================== */
const DB_NAME='inkos_db', DB_VER=4;
let db=null;
const STORES=['clients','events','payments','finance','tattooWork','photos','students','homework','inventory','cartridgeUsage','healingFilmSales','guestSpots','cities','reminders','tasks','notifications','settings','backups','projects','consents','auditLog'];
const EVENT_TYPES={
  session:{label:'Сеанс',color:'#20B2AA'},
  consult:{label:'Консультация',color:'#F4C542'},
  correction:{label:'Коррекция',color:'#E53935'},
  model:{label:'Модель',color:'#8E44AD'},
  dayoff:{label:'Выходной',color:'#FF7F50'},
  study:{label:'Учёба',color:'#2563EB'},
  university:{label:'Учёба в университете',color:'#60A5FA'},
  cleaning:{label:'Генеральная уборка',color:'#808080'},
  other:{label:'Другое',color:'#666666'}
};
const PAY_METHODS=['Карта','Наличные','Перевод','Рассрочка','Другое'];
const SERVICE_TYPES=['Тату'];
const BODY_ZONES=['Рука','Предплечье','Плечо','Кисть','Нога','Голень','Бедро','Стопа','Спина','Грудь','Живот','Шея','Голова','Другое'];
const STYLE_TAGS=['Олдскул','Традиционный','Неотрад','Ньюскул','Япония','Дарк леттеринг','Орнаментал','Полинезия','Цветной реализм','Биомеханика','Трайбл','Графика','Леттеринг','Black & Grey','Блэкворк','Минимализм','Cyber Sigil','Другое'];
const PAY_STATUS=['Не оплачено','Бронирование даты получено','Частично оплачено','Оплачено полностью','Возвращено','Рассрочка','Ожидается оплата'];
const CLIENT_STATUS=['Новый','Постоянный','VIP','Давно не был','Ожидает ответа','Запланирован повторный визит','Неактивный','Потерянный клиент'];
const MASTER_NAME='Рамзес (Роман Долженко)';
const CONSENT_TYPES={
  health:{
    label:'Подтверждение (нет противопоказаний)',
    title:'ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНИЕ',
    extraFields:[
      {key:'bookingAmount',label:'Сумма за бронирование даты'},
      {key:'tattooType',label:'Тип татуировки'},
      {key:'price',label:'Стоимость работы'}
    ],
    text:`ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНИЕ
Пожалуйста, внимательно прочитайте каждый из следующих пунктов:
1. Мастер гарантирует, что татуировка будет выполнена в стерильных условиях и с помощью специальных стерильных разовых инструментов.
2. const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const $$=s=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const uid=()=>'id'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8);
const fmtMoney=n=>{n=Number(n)||0;const cur=(S.settings&&S.settings.currency)||'₽';return n.toLocaleString('ru-RU',{maximumFractionDigits:0})+' '+cur;};
const fmtDate=d=>{ if(!d) return '—'; const dt=(d instanceof Date)?d:new Date(d); return dt.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU'); };
const fmtDateTime=d=>{ const dt=(d instanceof Date)?d:new Date(d); return dt.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')+' '+dt.toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); };
const todayISO=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const daysBetween=(a,b)=>Math.floor((new Date(b)-new Date(a))/86400000);
const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
function toast(msg,type){
  const w=$('#toastWrap');
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='toast';
  el.textContent=msg;
  w.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(()=>{el.style.opacity='0';el.style.transition='opacity .4s';setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),400);},3500);
}

}
